basic_profile.bio: SakeAndTaxes is a 28-year-old finance professional living in Toronto, Canada. With a background in accounting, they have an affinity for numbers and a passion for helping people navigate their taxes. When they're not crunching numbers, they enjoy indulging in sake tasting and sharing their discoveries on Reddit. They have a dry sense of humor and often browse r/funny for a good laugh. They are single and live with a Newfoundland dog named Bear, who sometimes stars in their posts on r/newfoundland. SakeAndTaxes typically spends evenings and weekends online, especially during tax season when they offer free advice to friends and family.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: SakeAndTaxes holds a Bachelor's degree in Accounting from the University of Toronto and has been working as a certified public accountant for the past five years. Their expertise in tax-related matters is largely drawn from professional experience, complemented by self-study and participation in webinars and workshops.
